name: Kinetic Clutches (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Pin, Kinetic Proficiency.

Benefit(s): When using an infusion which is part of an attack, charge, or full-attack action (such as kinetic blade), your blast is considered to have the grappling weapon quality. You do not become grappled when making a grapple with this attack, and consider your weapon reach to be 30 feet for maintaining grapples initiated with your blast’s grappling quality, but cannot use kinetic blasts except for those made through Kinetic Pin without ending the grapple.
